messages:
Cal (Design): Quick microcopy review for the token-cost tooltip in the dashboard. Current copy: `Estimated token usage per request`. Feels dry and doesn't explain rounding or variance.
Maya (PM): Users keep asking why estimates differ from billing. We should hint at rounding and context.
Priya (Copy): Drafts:
1) "Estimated tokens per request (approx.). Actual usage may vary based on prompt and model."
2) "Approximate token count. Final billing may vary."
Noah (Eng): Prefers short text. We already show exact token breakdown in the expanded panel. Tooltip should be concise but clear about approximation.
Samir (A11y): If we use "(approx.)" include a non-parenthetical alt: screen readers sometimes skip parenthetical content. Make sure the tooltip is reachable and link to docs has descriptive text.
Cal (Design): How about: "Approximate tokens per request. See details on how token counts are calculated." Keep link explicit.
Priya (Copy): Final suggestion: "Approximate tokens per request. Token counts are rounded and may differ from final billing. See how counts are calculated."
Maya (PM): Good. Ensure the link text is exactly `See how counts are calculated` so it's descriptive.
Noah (Eng): Implementation note: tooltip component truncates at ~80 chars. This is within limit but watch wrapping.
Samir (A11y): Add aria-label on the tooltip trigger: `Token estimate info`. Link aria-label: same as visible link text.
Cal (Design): I'll update Figma and add a small note: keep sentence case, period at end. Priya, can you push this to /docs/microcopy/tooltips.md?
Priya (Copy): Will do, will include SR notes.
